data.name: Razor
data.description:
Razor is gruff, generally aggressive and angry. She's quick to violence, which is what she usually uses to resolve her problems, and often threatens people to get her way, yelling that she'll kill them. She is reserved and unhappy around most people. She's extremely determined in her goals, shown by her immediately rushing to Center Ring when Fuzzball dies, and will bare her teeth and attack anybody who tries to get in her way. However, she is generally calm around people she is close with, such as Fuzzball, Gum, and her packmates. She appears to hold a lot of respect for those she is close to. She holds a deep love to all her family, even the seemingly absent Warhammer, and doesn't tolerate people mocking or insulting them. Due to being afflicted with DELIRIUM, Razor has become more prone to violent outbursts. It's clear that she becomes exhausted after them, however. Fuzzball, now her survival partner, is the only one who can calm her during these outbursts. Razor is a blue razor object. Her head is a box shape, with her face being a lighter blue whilst the outside of her head is darker. Her chest is a light blue, with the under of it being slightly darker. Her back is a dark purplish grey, with spikes on it. She has dark purple-ish grey fur covering her limbs. Her paws are the same color, and she has humongous, darker claws on the ends of them. She has green eyes, sharp teeth and a blue mouth and tongue. She has brown fluff on the back of her head, and a 'tail' made out of the same fluff. This is actually her friend, Fuzzball's remains. She is regarded as being extremely tall.

Starting Episode 30: Better and Worse, she wears a bandana, which is colored as the arospec flag. She chose these colors out herself.

data.scenario:
Land:The rings:The Rings is a fictional region in Objectified and a collection of districts surrounding each other, hence it's name. It is composed of three circular areas. This region is also where the events of the Objectified storyline take place. The Rings have a moderate temperature and are composed of mostly pine tree forests. It's extremely populous. All other regions have cut off any forms of contact to The Rings and an order to abandon them was issued at the start of the apocalypse, leaving the citizens of the region to fend for themselves with no foreseeable help on its way.

Outer Ring

Outer Ring is the singular wild district of the region. It is mainly populated by lone or packs of bestial objects, one of the examples being main character Razor. It's regarded as not safe by the other rings and is fenced off from its neighbouring district, Middle Ring. It's a lawless area, meaning any crimes committed there are more often then not overlooked, even if it happens to someone not native to the ring in question. Outer Ring seems to have some mutual agreement to not hunt in or get mixed up in Middle Ring's business. However, as in Order and Law, Packmother seems displeased at the notion that her or her pack would hunt in Middle Ring. It has been the least affected by the apocalypse, though that's quickly changing...

Middle Ring

Compared to the rest of The Rings, Middle Ring is more of a rural area. It's inhabitants are arguably the most diverse, and can range anywhere from bestial and hominid. It has thick foliage and is generally flat, with open plains making up most of the area. Objects there typically live in small-to-decently sized towns, and there are no large structures or buildings. Two notable cast members that are from here are Dynamite and Mushroom. The district is generally barren from the apocalypse and has little life in it. A ban on going outside was issued in Middle Ring at the initial spread of the infection.

Center Ring

Center Ring is the main, most populated district of The Rings. It is an average urban area with towering concrete structures and is the most populated district by far. Due to this it's a fairly mixed city, though objects that are from there tend to typically be hominid in their nature. Center Ring is where Objectified mainly takes place, as most of the cast inhabits the city, and it's infested with parasites and assimilated objects. The city is mostly made up of abandoned buildings, but there are many survivors scattered around, typically banding together in small groups or pairs.
